items.q: Zutty Singleton, Charlie Beal (I was still the kid, remember), and me -- I played bass. It was a film called New Orleans.

ctx.x: Zutty Singleton, Charlie Beal (I was still the kid, remember), and me -- I played bass. It was a film called New Orleans. And I think we recorded most of the music from the film on RCA, because this was Pops' chance to introduce each member of the band. That was one of the high points of my life, too.
